question: Where’s the closest hotel as you go toward Governor's Island Kayacking, New York, NY from Art Clinic, New York, NY?
sql: SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_city, p.addr_state FROM pois AS p, ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Art Clinic%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%New York%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NY%' LIMIT 1 ) AS origin_point, ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Governor''s Island Kayacking%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%New York%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NY%' LIMIT 1 ) AS destination_point WHERE p.tourism = 'hotel' AND p.addr_city ILIKE '%New York%' AND p.addr_state ILIKE '%NY%' -- Ensure the hotel is closer to the destination than the origin, -- which implies it's "as you go toward" the destination. AND ST_Distance(p.geometry::geography, destination_point.geometry::geography) < ST_Distance(p.geometry::geography, origin_point.geometry::geography) ORDER BY ST_Distance(p.geometry::geography, destination_point.geometry::geography) ASC LIMIT 1;
